source.title: 递归到底是什么？3分钟看懂递归
source.author: 猫小申

scope.zh-CN: 6张关键原帧及ASR响应文字核对；抽样审阅，未逐帧审看、未编译运行代码。
scope.en: Six key original frames and ASR response text checked; sampled review, not every-frame inspection or code compilation/execution.

summary.zh-CN: 用5辆车排队的动画解释递归：相同规则缩小问题，到队首取得确定答案，再逐层返回。区分动画类比、可见文字及语音不确定项。
summary.en: An animation of five cars explains recursion through smaller same-rule problems, a definite answer at the front, and successive returns. The result separates the analogy, visible text and speech uncertainty.

observation.zh-CN: 开场队列有5辆车，并给出队尾到队首的角色标签。
observation.en: The opening queue shows five cars and labels the roles from the back to the front.

observation.zh-CN: 队首气泡原文为“我第一啊”，复核修正了不精确转述。
observation.en: The front character’s bubble reads “我第一啊”; review corrected an imprecise rendering.

observation.zh-CN: 画面把当前位置与前一位置加一关联，强调规则不变。
observation.en: The visual relates the current position to the previous position plus one, emphasizing an unchanged rule.

observation.zh-CN: 画面明确标出终止条件，询问在队首停止。
observation.en: The image explicitly labels the base case: questioning stops at the front of the queue.

observation.zh-CN: 返回后各车位置确定，说明调用后仍有逐层回传过程。
observation.en: Positions are resolved after the return sequence, illustrating work propagated back through the chain.

observation.zh-CN: 尾帧仍有5辆车但没有角色标签，不能仅凭尾帧确定角色身份。
observation.en: The final frame still shows five cars but no role labels; it cannot establish character identities by itself.

corrections.zh-CN: 抽帧的全局位置与ASR原生时间分别标注，不把语句范围当作单帧持续时间。
corrections.en: Global frame positions and native ASR times are distinguished; an utterance range is not a frame duration.

corrections.zh-CN: 首个视觉请求只有8帧，不代表全任务缺少后续画面；全片实际提交68帧。
corrections.en: The first vision request contains only eight frames; it does not describe whole-job coverage, which submitted 68 frames.

corrections.zh-CN: 核对原帧，修正队首对话气泡文字。
corrections.en: Checked the original frame and corrected the front character’s speech-bubble text.

corrections.zh-CN: 转写缺字保留为识别不确定项，不能据此断言原视频音频截断。
corrections.en: Missing ASR words remain recognition uncertainty and do not establish that the source audio was truncated.

zh-CN: 本机案例，不代表异机或所有作品都能取得。
动画类比不等于程序实现或正确性证明。
未完整人工复听；模型原始输出有误时，以修订报告和复核记录为准。
实际提交量不是固定费用或平台结算账单。
登记媒体已清理；仅保留摘要、证据哈希和文字观察，不提供失效媒体链接。
en: A local case does not establish other-device or universal acquisition support.
An animated analogy is not an implementation or correctness proof.
No full manual audio listening; corrected report/review take precedence over erroneous model output.
Submitted quantities are not fixed costs or settled billing.
Registered media were removed; summaries, hashes and text observations remain without broken media links.

publication.zh-CN: 经宿主修订的公共摘要；不含原媒体、完整转写或私人请求记录。
publication.en: Public summary of the host-corrected result, without original media, full transcription or private request records.
